annotations.title: Hyperliquid whale tracker: top-300 accounts, long vs short, positions, changes

description: Call this when the user asks what Hyperliquid whales are doing, whether the biggest Hyperliquid accounts are net long or short a coin, for the largest open positions with liquidation prices, or what large accounts just opened, closed or flipped. Returns the live board of the 300 largest accounts by equity (scanned every 5 minutes, addresses only) and with events the last 200 position changes. Without coin, the 30 largest coins and positions; pass coin, or limit (up to 200) for more.

events.description: Include the last 200 position change events

limit.description: Optional. Coins and positions without coin, largest first (default 30).

name: get_hl_whales
